office_does: The elected Director of Community Development runs county planning, zoning, permitting, building codes and code enforcement, and drafts the comprehensive plan and development rules for the commissioners to adopt.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Bruce Emery, elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Director of Community Development since December 2022, a former county senior planner (1993-2007) and construction project manager (2007-2022); the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Names economic development and more housing, including multifamily, as his top priorities [S3]
Cites expanded agricultural accessory uses and stronger code enforcement; 87 cases closed in the second quarter of 2026 [S1][S4]
Led the comprehensive plan update now before the commissioners [S5]
